COMPOSITION LOCK: Exactly ONE coherent standalone subject. NO magnifying-glass panels, circular callouts, inset bubbles, enlarged detail frames, connecting leaders, arrows or pointers. Put any necessary anatomical cutaway directly inside the MAIN organ or body-part silhouette; do not add a separate scaled-up tissue panel. Empty surrounding alpha.

STYLE LOCK: outlines and coloring must match a clean hand-drawn 2D WEBTOON cel-painted illustration. Use a flat base fill plus at most two clean bounded shadow shapes. NO watercolor washes, mottled gouache fill, painterly marbling, stippled specimen texture, translucent jelly, glossy white reflections, gradients, chalky highlights or 3D volume shading. Paper grain if any must be barely perceptible. Keep negative space absolutely empty and transparent. Never crop the organism at the canvas edge.
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square central illustration for a medical card encyclopedia, standalone transparent RGBA PNG.
Style: hand-drawn 2D Korean indie fantasy webtoon combined with a vintage European picture-book. Thin natural dark-brown outlines, slight organic variation, clean clear silhouettes. Matte flat paint and only 1–2 discrete cel-shadow tones; extremely subtle paper grain inside paint only. Crisp, no beauty-filter softness, blur, haze, bloom, glossy highlights, strong gradients or realistic 3D.
Composition: one coherent main medical subject, centered and generously framed in a square with 6–10% empty margin. Legible at a small 150px thumbnail. No card frame, text, labels, arrows, numbers, lettered diagrams, logos, watermark, badges or decorative symbols.
Background: TRUE transparency (alpha=0) everywhere outside the subject. Keep all subject paint opaque, including pale membranes and cutaway tissues. Do not draw a white/gray/colored/checkerboard background, floor, ground, shadow or backdrop swash.
ABSOLUTELY NO surrounding effects: no sparkles, stars, diamonds, particles, scattered dots, petals, leaves, flowers, aura, halo, glow, magic rays/trails, bokeh, glitter or filler. Attached pathogen structures and necessary disease lesions are allowed, decorative substitutes are forbidden.
No weapons, drug bottle, fantasy mascot face, humanoid microbe or anthropomorphism.
Primary request: depict the named infectious disease through its main anatomical site and ONE characteristic symptom/lesion from the supplied clinical notes. Favor a clear isolated correct gross-anatomy cutaway or a natural relaxed person/body-part crop. Do not make a full multi-panel medical infographic. If showing a patient, use ordinary cream/earth-tone clothing, a believable mildly ill expression and an uncomplicated pose; no magical costumes. Hands only when necessary, with correct five fingers, coherent wrist-elbow-shoulder connection and no twisting reach behind the body; otherwise crop them naturally outside the frame. Feet must have exactly five toes. No detached extra limbs. Place internal anatomy at its correct position relative to the body's own left/right, using simple accurate shapes; do not invent detailed branches, bone joints or organs. A single local opaque organ overlay is acceptable; do not turn skin or the whole subject into translucent ghost material. Disease signs are localized actual lesions, not surrounding red rays, halos, arbitrary dots or glowing pain indicators. Non-graphic clinical depiction, no gratuitous gore or stigma. Do not illustrate rare complications as obligatory or fabricate a lesion for latent/asymptomatic infection.

Subject: 치쿤구니아열 (Chikungunya).
Anatomic sites: blood, bone, skin.
Clinical core: 모기 노출 뒤 급성 발열과 두드러진 관절통·종창. 관절 증상이 오래 남을 수 있고 뎅기열과 구분해야 한다.
Presentation: 신생아·고령·기저질환자는 중증 위험을 따로 본다.
Locked composition: Select the main clinical organ/site or characteristic visible skin pattern explicitly described in DB. A clothed natural patient crop is suitable for fever/rash; no fanciful virus-as-monster symbolism.

Locked composition: A natural isolated wrist/hand crop with five fingers and modest joint swelling across wrist/finger joints, no fractured or impossible bones.
